src.core.statistics.mean_delay.weighted_mean_delay(monthly_planned_trains: pandas.Series, delay_observations_to_average: pandas.Series) → float¶

Calculate a weighted mean of a series of delay observations weighted by the number of trains planned for each period.

This function can be used to calculate weighted means of the departure or arrival delays.

Both input Series must cover the same periods and have matching indexes. Observations with missing values or non-positive (<= 0) monthly planned train counts are excluded.

Parameters:

  • monthly_planned_trains (pd.Series) – the number of planned trains on the selected months. This Series should normally come from the MONTHLY_PLANNED_TRAINS_KEY. The Pandas Series must be filtered to only include the periods you want to include in the calculation.

  • delay_observations_to_average (pd.Series) – the delay measure or observations you wish to get the mean. The Pandas Series must be filtered to only include the periods you want to average.

Returns:

the delay weighted mean of the valid observations,

or NaN if no valid observations are available.

Return type:

float

src.core.statistics.mean_delay.ratio_number_of_trains(monthly_planned_trains: pandas.Series, train_observations: pandas.Series) → float¶

Calculate the ratio of observed trains to planned trains.

This function can be used to calculate the proportion of delayed or cancelled trains among planned trains over the selected periods.

Both input Series must cover the same periods and have matching indexes. Observations with missing values or invalid counts are excluded.

Parameters:

  • monthly_planned_trains (pd.Series) – Number of planned trains for each selected month, usually from MONTHLY_PLANNED_TRAINS_KEY. The Series must be filtered to the periods being studied.

  • train_observations (pd.Series) – Number of delayed or cancelled trains for each selected month. The Series must cover the same periods as monthly_planned_trains.

Returns:

The ratio of valid train observations to planned trains,

or NaN if no valid observations are available.

Return type:

float
